shared_elements: relief carving of figures on a flat panel/rock face
anthropomorphic or zoomorphic figure with head and limbs
justification: Both surfaces carry relief-carved figural imagery with curving, spiral-like elements and a creature/figure with discernible head and limbs, but that is a very generic correspondence. A shows a dense, framed, symmetrical composition of many elaborately costumed seated human figures flanking a central tree/axis with a decorative border, while B shows one or two isolated, large, schematic bird-man-like or animal figures with a bold outlined head and no framing, border, or narrative grouping.
